views.building_hawker_proximity:
SELECT building_id,
    hawker_id,
    distance_m,
    housing.proximity_class(distance_m) AS proximity_class
   FROM housing.building_hawker;
views.nearest_hawker:
SELECT building_id,
    hawker_id,
    distance_m,
    housing.proximity_class(distance_m) AS proximity_class
   FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (building_hawker.building_id) building_hawker.building_id,
            building_hawker.hawker_id,
            building_hawker.distance_m
           FROM housing.building_hawker
          ORDER BY building_hawker.building_id, building_hawker.distance_m, building_hawker.hawker_id) nearest;
views.nearest_market_hawker:
SELECT building_id,
    hawker_id,
    distance_m,
    housing.proximity_class(distance_m) AS proximity_class
   FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (bh.building_id) bh.building_id,
            bh.hawker_id,
            bh.distance_m
           FROM housing.building_hawker bh
             JOIN housing.hawker_centre h USING (hawker_id)
          WHERE h.market_produce_stalls > 0
          ORDER BY bh.building_id, bh.distance_m, bh.hawker_id) nearest_market;

functions.proximity_class:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION housing.proximity_class(distance_m double precision)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE STRICT
AS $function$
    SELECT CASE WHEN distance_m < 0 OR distance_m > 2000 THEN NULL
                WHEN distance_m < 500 THEN 'near'
                WHEN distance_m < 1000 THEN 'medium'
                ELSE 'far' END
$function$
functions.haversine_m:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION housing.haversine_m(lat1 double precision, lon1 double precision, lat2 double precision, lon2 double precision)
 RETURNS double precision
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE STRICT
AS $function$
    SELECT 2 * 6371008.8 * asin(sqrt(least(1.0, greatest(0.0,
        power(sin(radians(lat2-lat1)/2), 2)
        + cos(radians(lat1))*cos(radians(lat2))
          * power(sin(radians(lon2-lon1)/2), 2)))))
$function$
